name: Wire Stripping and Payment-Message Manipulation
description: Payment messages can be altered or structured so that names, addresses or purpose fields that would trigger sanctions screening are omitted, truncated or replaced. Controls focus on message integrity, intermediary practices and unusual patterns in message content.

sources.text: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision, Due diligence and transparency regarding cover payment messages related to cross-border wire transfers (2009)
FATF Recommendation 16 and Interpretive Note on wire transfers
OFAC, Enforcement Release guidance on payment processing (general reference)

exposure.rationale: Payment-message manipulation in SWIFT and correspondent routing.
